name: Well fed
description: A hearty meal bolsters your Health for up to one full day, ending on sleep.

name: Sustained energy
description: Bread provides extra Energy capacity for up to one full day, ending on sleep.

name: Clear focus
description: White tablets sharpen your mind for up to one full day, ending on sleep.

name: Restored physique
description: Painkillers bolster your physique for up to one full day, ending on sleep.

name: Steroid physique
description: Steroids increase Physique by 2 for up to one full day, ending on sleep.

name: Steroid concentration
description: Steroids increase Concentration by 1 for up to one full day, ending on sleep.

name: Liquid courage
description: 40% alcohol grants +40% fear resistance for up to one full day, ending on sleep. Replaces other alcohol fear resistance.

name: Liquid courage (5%)
description: 5% alcohol grants +5% fear resistance for up to one full day, ending on sleep. Replaces other alcohol fear resistance.

name: Liquid courage (12%)
description: 12% alcohol grants +12% fear resistance for up to one full day, ending on sleep. Replaces other alcohol fear resistance.

name: Liquid courage (60%)
description: 60% alcohol grants +60% fear resistance for up to one full day, ending on sleep. Replaces other alcohol fear resistance.

name: Clouded mind

name: Nicotine focus

name: Nicotine fatigue

name: Strong nicotine focus
description: Strong nicotine focus: +2 Concentration until four phases pass or you sleep.

name: Strong nicotine fatigue
description: Strong nicotine fatigue: -2 Physique until four phases pass or you sleep.

name: Mental exertion

name: Pain relief

name: Steroid protection

name: Protective treatment

name: Lasting treatment

name: Treatment endurance
description: Lasting treatment grants +20 maximum Health and +10 maximum Energy for four phases or until sleep.

name: Field treatment
description: Field treatment grants +25 maximum Health and +15 maximum Energy for four phases or until sleep. Does not restore current Health or Energy.

name: Field endurance

name: Comprehensive treatment

name: Comprehensive endurance
description: Comprehensive treatment grants +30 maximum Health, +20 maximum Energy and +1 Concentration, improving its related skills, for four phases or until sleep. Does not restore current Health or Energy.

name: Clinical focus

name: Visible matchlight

name: Mental balance
description: White tablets grant +15 maximum Sanity for four phases or until sleep.
